✳FROM MONDAY TO SUNDAY

OUR STORY.

No matter how busy our weekdays are or how relaxed our weekends feel, our pets always fill every corner of our lives with the same boundless enthusiasm and unconditional love.

Yet, we realized that the treats we gave them often failed to live up to that pure affection—some were dull and tasteless, others came with hidden worries. We believe our dogs deserve better—something that lets them enjoy delicious and fun of chewing in every single day, from Monday to Sunday.

That’s why MON2SUN was born. We are devoted to selecting high-quality ingredients and crafting each product with meticulous care, blending nutrition and flavor into every bite. These are not just treats—they’re a way to honor the daily ritual that connects you and your beloved companion.

From the Monday boost of energy to the Sunday evening of relaxation, MON2SUN hopes to bring visible quality and genuine fun to every day you share together.

At MON2SUN, we provide fun of chewing from Monday to Sunday!

01Where are MON2SUN treats made, and where do the ingredients come from?+

MON2SUN is a pet brand focused on the U.S. market. Our products are manufactured in China under established quality control practices and in accordance with applicable safety standards.

02Which treat should I choose for my dog's size and chewing style?+

Choose a treat for your dog’s size, age and chewing habits. If you’re avoiding rawhide, Chicken Wrapped Codfish Sticks and Chicken Wrapped Sweet Potato are options to compare. For a single-ingredient treat, our Freeze-Dried Chicken Cubes contain only chicken breast. Check the specific product’s size guidance and avoid a chew your dog can swallow whole. If your dog gulps chews or has dental problems, ask your vet which type is appropriate.

03Are MON2SUN dog treats safe for dogs?+

Suitability depends on the specific treat and your dog. Choose a size and texture that match your dog’s chewing habits, and check for ingredients your dog needs to avoid. Always supervise chewing and take the chew away if your dog tries to swallow it whole or when the remaining piece is small enough to swallow. If your dog swallows a large piece or becomes unwell, contact your vet; choking or trouble breathing needs emergency care.

04Where do you ship, how much does shipping cost, and when will my order arrive?+

We use Amazon MCF to ship orders to the contiguous United States and Washington, D.C. For delivery to Micronesia or Palau, please contact us before ordering to confirm availability. Standard shipping is $5 for orders under $50 and free for orders of $50 or more, based on the merchandise subtotal after discounts and before tax. Delivery times vary by destination and shipping service. Email support@mon2sun.com for an estimate before ordering.

05What kinds of dog treats does MON2SUN offer?+

Our range includes rawhide, rawhide-free and rawhide-alternative chews, meat jerky, chicken-wrapped biscuits and freeze-dried treats. You’ll find different recipes, shapes and sizes, from sticks and rolls to strips and cubes. Browse our full range to see the current options.
